title: Curried Bulgur Salad
description: Bulgur wheat cooked with curry powder and tossed with chickpeas, apple, raisins, almonds and vegetables in a honey-lemon dressing.
ingredients: 400g (14oz) can of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
1 crunchy apple (such as Granny Smith), peeled, cored and finely chopped
1 red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
small handful of mint leaves, finely chopped, plus extra to serve
DRESSING: juice of 1 lemon, 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp coarse sea salt
steps: Put the bulgur wheat into a pan, cover with the stock and stir in the curry powder and spring onions. Bring to a simmer, cover with a lid and simmer gently for about 12 minutes until tender.
Remove from the heat, fluff with a fork, then cover again and leave to rest for 10 minutes.
Transfer the cooked bulgur wheat to a large bowl and add the chickpeas, apple, raisins, almonds, carrot, red pepper and mint.
Mix up the dressing ingredients in a small bowl, then pour over the salad and stir thoroughly. Season with salt to taste. Serve scattered with more fresh mint.
notes: A great pot-luck or packed lunch dish. Serves well alongside curried chicken or lamb. Prep time excludes resting.
